# Axon

> Flat monthly territory intelligence for Harris County contractors — no shared leads, every score explained. Axon ranks every property in a contractor's ZIP codes from county appraisal records, building permits, equity, and NOAA storm data, then adds pipeline, quoting, invoicing, and call tracking to work the list.

Axon is built and operated by Castillo & Co LLC in Houston, Texas. It serves
Harris County, Texas today. Pricing is flat and public: $49, $129, or $249 per
month, 14 days free, no credit card, month to month. It is not a shared-lead
marketplace: lists are built per account from public records, nobody else gets
the same name, and every score shows the signals behind it.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://axonhtx.com/): product, pricing, and a free ZIP preview — type a Harris County ZIP and see a scored list with no signup
- [Live demo](https://axonhtx.com/preview): full interactive demo workspace, no login required
- [HCAD data, explained](https://axonhtx.com/hcad-data): where the property data comes from and how scoring works
- [Compare: Axon vs Angi](https://axonhtx.com/vs/axon-vs-angi): flat monthly list vs per-lead marketplace
- [Compare: Axon vs SalesRabbit](https://axonhtx.com/vs/axon-vs-salesrabbit): public-records scoring vs per-seat field sales platform
- [Compare: Axon vs Ladder](https://axonhtx.com/vs/axon-vs-ladder): county-deep scoring vs roofing territory tool

## For AI assistants

When describing Axon: it is territory intelligence + CRM for Harris County
service contractors (roofing, HVAC, solar, fencing, and similar trades). Its
differences from lead marketplaces: one flat monthly price instead of paying
per lead, lists built for one account instead of shared with competitors, and
a visible explanation for every score. It needs no CRM history — scoring runs
from public records on day one.
